_comment: Exact git refs (tag or SHA) of pine-lang and beamlynx-ui bundled into this desktop build. Checked out directly by CI via these refs -- update deliberately as part of a release, per RELEASING.md. pine-lang bumped to its tagged 0.55.0 (date periods, errors that list aliases/joins/close columns, one database as two users, count under masking); beamlynx-ui bumped to its tagged 0.75.0 (Connecting… at startup, tidy anywhere, Library by connection, saved tabs without database addresses). beamlynx-ui 0.75.0 needs pine-lang 0.55 (its RequiredVersion).
